author: Antonialock
body:
Thanks Val, This prediction comes from EXP evidence on cerevisiae generated from a Rhea reaction. I have removed the mapped annotations in protein2GO and the rhea reaction in UniProt -  the substrates used in the assays are not physiologically relevant.

There was also an EXP dictybase annotation to the polymerase term (coannotated with tRNA guanylyltransferase activity). I disputed this annotation.
